ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 60:40 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary white fields on both lobes with dense dark mottling. Specific dark circular spots are mapped across the left lobe mid-section. Solid dark pigmentation is concentrated around the median notch and proximal trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 75 degrees and a significant bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge topography characterized by high-frequency, high-amplitude serrations. Notable sharp peaks are visible along the upper margins of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex mathematical curve fitted to the outer edges of the fluke lobes from the notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of several distinct dark-on-white circular pixel clusters on the left lobe and lighter ring-like rosettes near the right lobe tip, consistent with barnacle scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical and diagonal linear pixel disruptions are visible crossing the light-pigmented regions of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss and jagged serrations along the trailing edge; heavy calcification or barnacle clusters are visible at the distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique focal clustering of dark circular 'leopard spots' on the white background of the left lobe's central region.
